newsitem.title: FINLAND: Enso buys majority of German E.Holtzmann.
newsitem.headline: Enso buys majority of German E.Holtzmann.

text.p: Finland's second largest forest industry group Enso Oy said on Monday it had bought 50.4 percent of shares in German newsprint and magazine paper group E.Holtzmann for 1.8 billion markka.

"Enso intends to acquire Holtzmann's entire share capital," it said in a statement, adding it would take over operational responsibility immediately. At the time of the sale, Holtzmann had no interest-bearing liabilities, Enso said.
